title.zh: 将巴拉望省Roxas市镇Mendoza描笼涯PNAC Bayanihan中学从Aborlan市镇巴拉望国立农业学院分离，改设为独立的Mendoza国立农业中学的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Existing Pnac Bayanihan High School in Barangay Mendoza, Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, From the Palawan National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Aborlan, Province of Palawan, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Mendoza National Agricultural High School
title.orig: An Act Separating the Existing Pnac Bayanihan High School in Barangay Mendoza, Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, From the Palawan National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Aborlan, Province of Palawan, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Mendoza National Agricultural High School
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Trường Trung học Existing Pnac Bayanihan tại Barangay Mendoza, Đô thị Roxas, Tỉnh Palawan khỏi Cao đẳng Nông nghiệp Palawan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Nông nghiệp Mendoza Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Existing Pnac Bayanihan ในบารังไกย์ Mendoza เทศบาล Roxas จังหวัด Palawan ออกจากวิทยาลัยเกษตรกรรม Palawan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเกษตรกรรม Mendoza แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Sekolah Menengah Existing Pnac Bayanihan di Barangay Mendoza, Kotamadya Roxas, Provinsi Palawan dari Sekolah Tinggi Pertanian Palawan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pertanian Mendoza Nasional
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Sekolah Menengah Existing Pnac Bayanihan di Barangay Mendoza, Perbandaran Roxas, Wilayah Palawan daripada Kolej Pertanian Palawan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pertanian Mendoza Kebangsaan

text.en: The existing PNAC Bayanihan High School in Barangay Mendoza, Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, is hereby separated from the Palawan National Agricultural College in the Municipality of Aborlan, Province of Palawan, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Mendoza National Agricultural High School, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for the implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
